MATCH (item:PlantItem {tag: 'M-601'})-[:is_drawn_on]->(sheet:Sheet)

MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'TK-601'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'P-601C'})

MATCH (source:PlantItem {tag: 'P-402'})
MATCH (target:PlantItem)
WHERE (target:Equipment OR target:Valve)
  AND target.unit_id = '4'
  AND EXISTS { (source)-[:line_to*1..]->(target) }
RETURN DISTINCT target.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag

MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'EA-701'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'NV-7001'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(b))
UNWIND range(0, size(nodes(p)) - 1) AS i
WITH nodes(p)[i] AS n, i
WHERE n:Equipment OR n:Valve
RETURN n.tag AS tag
ORDER BY i
